findings.detail: X02 incorrectly requires a rate on unfunded delayed-draw and revolver commitment rows whose source rate cells are blank.

rationale: The filing schedule itself leaves Interest Term and Interest Rate blank for the flagged unfunded commitment rows. Klick delayed-draw and revolver rows have negative cost and fair value, and Pipe Bidco's delayed-draw row likewise has a dash principal and negative cost/fair value; adjacent funded term-loan rows disclose rates (8.67% for Klick and 6.60% for Pipe Bidco). The stored blank is therefore faithful to source, while X02 is overbroad because it applies the funded-loan rate requirement to commitment/fee rows classified as PRIVATE_CREDIT.
